scope: Paired SIMLOX 2017 CLI comparison of MaterielPM.ENFNC=N versus Y when one explicit noncritical failure and one noncritical calendar PM await the same aircraft and shared maintenance worker. Compare native task initiation, resource order and completion, not only final readiness.

manual.rule: MaterielPM.ENFNC defaults to N; Y enforces noncritical repair actions before a noncritical PM on the same system. The manual's normal order is critical repair, critical PM, noncritical PM, noncritical repair. Direct event evidence is required for this particular overlap.

frozen_source_delta: Derive both arms from accepted D08.var03 failure-mode CRITF=0 input, retaining the first scheduled mission and explicit FM-POS-A direct repair route.

Enable PM; shorten simulation and collection horizon 36 to 14 hours; add one 9.9-hour calendar PM with DTIM=0.5 and MNOCC=1; add shared P-MAINT resource and half-hour CM/one-hour PM subtasks; bind CM to its task.
The paired arms differ only in descriptive text and PM9P9.ENFNC N versus Y.
acceptance_hypotheses: A noncritical FM-POS-A failure occurs before the first mission returns at hour 10; PM9P9 is due while that mission is active. Confirm from native logs, because source changes can alter random draws.

At return, both noncritical tasks are pending. Native ENFNC=N and Y event traces differ in their CM/PM initiation or actual work order in the direction documented by the manual. Determine exact times and worker leases from the native log.

Both arms retain every authored populated cell through native import/export, converter zero errors and usable outputs. Reconcile events with contiguous System and Resource report bins and terminal state.
gate: If the necessary noncritical failure/PM overlap or a pairwise ENFNC scheduling difference is absent, preserve this immutable run as an excluded diagnostic and revise a new version. Publish only directly observed ordering with separate read-only replay; do not claim general priority, PMRID, other failure/PM criticality or counter behavior.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID 13340/session 1 active and identity-preserved, immutable run path, 60-second targeted child watchdog, source/tool hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One explicit noncritical failure mode, one calendar PM, one aircraft/base/worker and one seed. No general ENFNC law, critical PM contrast, PMRID interaction, remote-base, GUI or cross-engine claim.
Only the first mission falls within the 14-hour result horizon; later inherited schedule rows remain outside the window.
